headline: Banks down. United down. Microsoft found its bug. Still here.

items.line: Chase, Bank of America and Wells Fargo lost online banking for part of Monday. Chase blames a technical issue, not a cyberattack.
items.title: Customers of Chase, Bank of America and other U.S. banks report service outages

items.line: United's systems went down for an hour and a half and departures were delayed.
items.title: 1.5-hour-long system outage forces United Airlines to delay departing flights

items.line: Microsoft says a bug hiding since July took out over 80% of its servers in the global Outlook outage.
items.title: Microsoft reveals hidden bug behind global Outlook and Microsoft 365 outage

items.line: An Nvidia-led sell-off pushed the Nasdaq into a correction. Line went down. It usually comes back.
items.title: US stocks fall as Nvidia-led sell-off pushes Nasdaq into correction

items.line: A magnitude 6.6 earthquake hit off Indonesia and was felt as far as Darwin, Australia.
items.title: M 6.6 - 148 km WSW of Tual, Indonesia

items.line: Three goats are loose in East Greenwich and, per the headline, "faster than you think."
items.title: ‘Faster than you think’: 3 goats on the loose in East Greenwich
